hero.name: Bhavya Patel
hero.headline: I build things
hero.supportingText: Student researcher and builder exploring software, AI, product systems, and emerging computing.

currentFocus: Exploring agent systems and applied AI
aboutSummary: I am an undergraduate student at Kennesaw State University interested in the space where software, research, and practical products meet. My work ranges from student tools and agent systems to machine-learning experiments and emerging computing.
closingStatement: The common thread is curiosity made concrete: a question, a system, and something useful enough to test.
